mode.description: The operation mode for tar: create, extract, list, append, diff, update.

archive_path.description: The path to the archive file. Maps to the --file option.

sources.description: A list of source file or directory paths to operate on. Maps to positional arguments.

compression.description: Compression filter to use: gzip, bzip2, xz, none.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output. Maps to --verbose or -v.

format.description: Archive format to use. Maps to --format. Valid: gnu, posix, ustar, v7.

preserve_permissions.description: Preserve permissions of extracted files. Maps to --preserve-permissions.

exclude_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to exclude from the archive or extraction. Maps to --exclude.
